launch_command:
surfacePaths:
  - src/**
launch: node src/launch.js
stop: node src/launch.js stop
runfile: .tmp/runtime.json
probes:
  - path: /healthz
    method: GET
    status: 200
    bodyShape: '{ status: string }'
  - path: /widgets
    method: GET
    status: 200
    bodyShape: '{ widgets: array }'
